parameters.name: images
parameters.description: One to four source/reference images to edit (URL or Base64-encoded JPEG/PNG/WEBP).

parameters.name: instruction
parameters.description: Text-based edit instruction (e.g. 'make the sky blue'). Required unless you supply structured_instruction instead.

parameters.name: structured_instruction
parameters.description: JSON structured instruction returned from a previous edit's response. Pass it back (optionally with the same seed) to precisely recreate or refine that result.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: Optional black-and-white mask (URL or Base64). Black is preserved, white is edited. Only supported with a single source image, matching its dimensions.

parameters.name: aspect_ratio
parameters.description: Aspect ratio of the output image. Defaults to the first source image's ratio if left unset.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Optional seed for deterministic generation. Leave blank for a random result; reuse a returned seed to reproduce it.

parameters.name: output_type
parameters.description: File format of the edited image.
